ROOMMATE AGREEMENT

This Roommate Agreement is between Alex Chen and Sam Ortiz, who share the apartment at 14 Elm Street under a lease with the landlord.

1. Rent. Each roommate will pay half of the monthly rent of $2,400.

2. Utilities. Utilities are split equally.

3. Security Deposit. Each roommate paid half of the security deposit.

4. Moving Out. A roommate who moves out early must give 30 days' notice and find a replacement tenant.
